REPÚBLICA DE MOÇAMBIQUE

MINISTÉRIO DOS TRANSPORTES E LOGÍSTICA

PROJECTO DE MOBILIDADE URBANA NA ÁREA METROPOLITANA DE MAPUTO

Grant N°: IDA-V374-MZ

 

PEDIDO DE MANIFESTAÇÃO DE INTERESSE

CONTRATAÇÃO DE CONSULTOR(A) INDIVIDUAL

ESPECIALISTA EM PLANIFICAÇÃO DE TRANSPORTE

N° 100/CONS/MMAUMP/25

O Governo de Moçambique, representado pelo Ministério dos Transportes e Logística, recebeu um financiamento do Banco Mundial para implementar o Projecto de Mobilidade Urbana na Área Metropolitana de Maputo (PMUAMM). O PMUAM tem por objectivo, melhorar a mobilidade e acessibilidade ao longo dos corredores seleccionados na Área Metropolitana de Maputo (AMM). O projecto será implementado na área que engloba o Distrito de Marracuene; o Município da Cidade de Maputo; Município da Cidade da Matola e Município da Vila de Boane.

O Ministério dos Transportes e Logística solicita a candidatura de consultores individuais interessados, qualificados e elegíveis para desempenhar a função de Especialista em Planificação de Transporte Urbano, que estará baseado(a) na Unidade de Coordenação do Projecto, e deverá fornecer consultoria estratégica e analítica, além de suporte técnico, à Unidade de Implementação de Projetos (PTU 1 – AMT). O Planificador de Transportes desenvolverá a capacidade da AMT para planejar rotas, serviços e horários tanto para serviços BRT quanto para serviços convencionais. Ele/Ela elaborará o plano de serviço inicial para as rotas BRT e seus respectivos alimentadores, monitorando e ajustando-os conforme necessário, de acordo com a demanda real. À medida que o sistema BRT se estabilizar, ele/ela estenderá sua atuação para rotas convencionais e, por fim, para serviços informais de táxi coletivo (Chapa), de modo a desenvolver uma rede multimodal integrada.

  QUALIFICAÇÕES

O Planificador de Transportes selecionado deve ser um profissional experiente, com formação superior em transportes, engenharia, economia ou ciências sociais e com experiência comprovada em planeamento ou operação de transportes.

  • O Planificador de Transportes deve ter pelo menos 7 anos de experiência relevante no setor de transporte público urbano;
  • Ampla experiência em avaliação de demanda, planejamento de rotas, programação e otimização de recursos;
  • Experiência e conhecimento em projetos de BRT (Bus Rapid Transit) são uma vantagem, incluindo o projeto e/ou implementação de instalações de transporte

   Requisitos Preferenciais

  • Excelente capacidade de organização e de trabalho em ambiente de pressão;
  • Capacidade de trabalhar com equipas multidisciplinares e de forma independente;
  • Os candidatos interessados ​​deverão enviar uma carta de manifestação de interesse e aptidão para a vaga, bem como um Curriculum Vitae, em inglês e português. Atenção especial aos consultores interessados para a Secção III, Parágrafos 3.14, 3.16 e 3.17 do “Regulamento de Aquisições para Mutuários do IPF” do Banco Mundial, de Fevereiro de 2025, estabelecendo as políticas do Banco Mundial sobre conflito de interesse.

Para obter mais informações, os interessados poderão adquirir os termos de referência por meio físico durante o horário de expediente (08h00 às 15h00) e eletrónico nos endereços abaixo.

As manifestações de interesse, deverão ser submetidas em Português, nos endereços abaixo, até as 10.00 horas do dia 23 de Fevereiro de 2026.

REQUEST FOR EXPRESSIONS OF INTEREST

(CONSULTING SERVICES – FIRMS SELECTION)

SAINT VINCENT AND THE GRENADINES (SVG)

BERYL EMERGENCY RESILIENT RECOVERY PROJECT (BERRy)

(IDA 76430)

Assignment Title: Design and construction supervision for the Rehabilitation of the Bequia Fisheries Wharf and Sea Defense

Reference No. SVG-BERRY-CS-QCBS-01

The Government of Saint Vincent and the Grenadines (GoSVG) has received financing from the World Bank toward the cost of the Beryl Emergency Resilient Recovery Project and it intends to apply part of the proceeds for consulting services for the design and supervision consultancy for the Design and Construction Supervision for the Rehabilitation of the Bequia Fisheries Wharf and Sea Defense.

 The consulting services (“the Services”) include the following:

  1. A detailed engineering assessment of current port side facilities (wharf and patio).
  2. Detailed designs for the approved interventions.
  3. An environmental assessment in accordance with World Bank requirements that compares and presents the anticipated impacts associated with feasible engineering control options identified.
  4. The provision all technical documentation required to support the procurement of a construction contractor to complete the required works.
  5. The supervision of repair and rehabilitation activities as well as supervision of the construction of sea defenses.

The duration of this consultancy is estimated to be 30 months (12 months for the design phase and 18 months for the supervision phase).

The Terms of Reference (TOR) for the assignment can be accessed using the following link:

https://procurement.gov.vc/eprocure/images/pdf/CurrentBids/Bequia%20Wharf%20Rehab%20and%20Sea%20Defense-%20REoI%20-%20Website%20-%20Feb2026.pdf

The Ministry of Finance, Economic Planning and Private Sector Development now invites eligible consulting firms (“Consultants”) to indicate their interest in providing the Services. Interested consultants must provide information demonstrating that they have the required qualifications and relevant experience to perform the Services. The shortlisting criteria are:

  1. Firms should have proven expertise in coastal engineering, hydrodynamics, and structural design for marine infrastructure.
  2. At  least seven (7) years’ experience in delivering projects of similar scope (involving sea walls, breakwaters, wharf rehabilitation, dredging).

 Key Experts will not be evaluated at this shortlisting stage.

The attention of interested Consultants is drawn to Section III, paragraphs, 3.14, 3.16, and 3.17 of the World Bank’s “Procurement Regulations for IPF Borrowers” 5th Edition September 2023 (“Procurement Regulations”), setting forth the World Bank’s policy on conflict of interest. In addition, consultants shall refer to the requirements on conflict of interest related to this assignment as per paragraph 3.17 of the Procurement Regulations. 

Consultants may associate with other firms to enhance their qualifications but should indicate clearly whether the association is in the form of a joint venture and/or a sub-consultancy. In the case of a joint venture, all the partners in the joint venture shall be jointly and severally liable for the entire contract, if selected.

A Consultant will be selected in accordance with the Consultant’s Quality and Cost Based Selection (QCBS) method set out in the Procurement Regulations.

Kegiatan ini akan dilaksanakan oleh 1 (satu) Konsultan Individu selama jangka waktu 3
(tiga) bulan sejak tanggal dimulainya penugasan, Kerangka Acuan Kerja yang lebih rinci untuk penugasan ini dapat diakses melalui tautan https://bit.ly/Assistant_Coastal_Management

Direktorat Jenderal Pengelolaan Kelautan Cq Loka PSPL Sorong mengundang Konsultan Individu yang memenuhi syarat untuk menyampaikan minat dalam memberikan Jasa sebagaimana dimaksud. Konsultan Individu yang berminat harus memberikan informasi yang menunjukkan bahwa mereka memiliki kualifikasi yang diperlukan dan pengalaman relevan untuk melaksanakan Jasa tersebut (dilengkapi dengan curriculum vitae yang memuat uraian pengalaman dalam penugasan serupa, kondisi serupa, dan lain-lain, termasuk Surat Pengantar dan surat referensi). Kriteria kualifikasi adalah sebagai berikut:

  1. Gelar Sarjana dalam disiplin ilmu Kelautan/Perikanan/lingkungan/Biologi/Geografi;
  2. Paling sedikit 6 (enam) bulan pengalaman yang relevan sebagai surveyor (dalam proyek pengelolaan ekosistem laut/pesisir/penataan ruang laut), lebih disukai dengan program bilateral atau multilateral yang didanai donor misalnya Bank Dunia, Bank Pembangunan Asia, dan Lembaga Donor pembangunan multilateral lainnya;
  3. Berpengalaman bekerja pada program Kelautan dan Perikanan dan/atau pendampingan masyarakat di Indonesia paling sedikit selama 6 (enam) bulan;
  4. Memiliki keahlian dalam Sistem Informasi Geografis (SIG) dan/atau Penginderaan Jauh/Remote Sensing lebih diutamakan;
  5. Memiliki sertifikat sebagai pilot drone lebih diutamakan;
  6. Memiliki sertifikat selam minimal A1/Basic/Setara lebih diutamakan;
  7. Memiliki kemampuan dalam membuat analisis penginderaan jauh kelautan dan perikanan lebih diutamakan;
  8. Memiliki pengalaman paling sedikit 6 (enam) bulan dalam monitoring dan/atau analisis data biofisik, sosial ekonomi dan budaya sektor Kelautan dan Perikanan

Konsultan Individu yang berminat harap memperhatikan prosedur dalam paragraph 3.14, 3.16 dan 3.17 dari The World Bank Procurement Regulations for IPF Borrowers, Sixth Edition February 2025 (“Regulation”) tentang kebijakan Bank dunia mengenai konflik kepentingan. Informasi lebih lanjut dapat diperoleh di alamat berikut selama jam kerja (08.00 hingga 16.00 WIB/GMT+7). Pernyataan minat harus disampaikan secara tertulis beserta Curriculum Vitae ke alamat di bawah ini melalui email paling lambat hari Selasa, 04 November 2025 pukul 08.00 WIB.

REQUEST FOR EXPRESSIONS OF INTEREST

 

 

Country:

The Republic of Uzbekistan

Project:

Water Services and Institutional Support (WASIS) Project funded by the International Development Association

Assignment Title:

Audits of the annual consolidated financial statements of
JSC “Uzsuvtaminot”, prepared in accordance with IFRS

Reference №:

WASIS-RFQ-IFRS

Date of Publication

09 February 2026

 

On 17th May 2021, the Republic of Uzbekistan and the International Development Association (IDA) signed a financing agreement for a total amount of USD 239,0 million, and a grant agreement with the State Secretariat for Economic Affairs of the Swiss Confederation (SECO) for USD 7,8 million to finance the “Water Services and Institutional Support” (WASIS) Project.

 

The consulting services (“the Services”) include Consolidated Financial Statements based on IFRS.

 

Objective:

The objective of the external audit of the annual consolidated financial statements of the JSC “Uzsuvtaminot” Group, prepared in accordance with IFRS, is to enable independent auditors to express an objective opinion on whether the financial statements present fairly, in all material respects, the consolidated financial position of the JSC “Uzsuvtaminot” Group, its consolidated financial performance and consolidated cash flows for the reporting year in accordance with IFRS, as well as to enable the Client and the shareholders of the JSC “Uzsuvtaminot” Group to use the audit results in making management decisions.

Throughout the process, the Consultant should work under the guidance of "Uzsuvtaminot" JSC in close cooperation with advisors and other consultants of "Uzsuvtaminot" JSC. The main objective of this assignment is Audit services for the annual audit of the accounting (financial) statements of a joint-stock company, taking into account its organizational structure.

The duration of this consulting assignment overall be 9 months and period of the contract 12-18 months. The consulting services are expected to start in March 2026.

The implementation progress above might change based on the actual conditions, and the actual input of time will be determined by the clients and WB based on the actual conditions of the Project. The contract may be extended upon justified demand, demonstration of satisfactory performance by the firm and interest between the parties, until the closing date of the Project.

The estimated level of effort for these Consulting Services is estimated to be in the range of USD 0.48 million.

The Terms of Reference of this assignment are available on request by emailing the PMU at wasis@uzsuv.uz

Uzsuvtaminot JSC as the Implementing Agency now invites eligible consulting firms (“Consultants”) to indicate their interest in providing the Services. Interested Consultants should provide information demonstrating that they have the required qualifications and relevant experience to perform the Services. Expression of interest should cover, but not limited to: corporate profile, years in business, experience relevant to the project activities, key staff resources, and core business.

 

Consultants may associate with other firms in the form of a joint venture or a sub consultancy to enhance their qualifications. In case of a Joint Venture (JV), all members of the JV will be evaluated jointly for the purpose of short listing and shall be jointly and severally liable for the assignment and shall sign the contract in case of award is made to that JV group. Interested consultants should clearly indicate the structure of their “association” and the duties of the partners and sub consultants in their application. Unclear expression of interests in terms of “in association with” and/or “in affiliation with” and etc. may not be considered for short listing. Keeping one expression of interest per firm as principle, a consultant firm may decide whether it wishes to participate as a sub consultant or as an individual consultant or as a partner in a joint venture. Please note that a firm shall submit only one EOI in the same selection process either individually as a consultant or as a partner in a joint venture. No firm can be a sub consultant while submitting an EOI individually or as a partner of a joint venture in the same selection process. A firm, if acting in the capacity of sub consultant in any consultant or JV, may participate in more than one consultant, but only in the capacity of a sub consultant. The experience of sub-consultant will not be considered while short-listing.

 

The attention of interested Consultants is drawn to Section III, paragraphs, 3.14, 3.16, and 3.17 of the World Bank’s “Procurement Regulations for IPF Borrowers” dated July 2016, revised November 2017 and August 2018 (“Procurement Regulations”), setting forth the World Bank’s policy on conflict of interest. 

A Consultant will be selected in accordance with the Least Cost Selection (LQS) method set out in the Procurement Regulations.

 

Shortlisting Criteria:

The consultant must have the following demonstrated experience:

  • General Experience: Proven track record as a leading consulting firm in conducting of audits of the annual consolidated financial statements of Entities, prepared in accordance with IFRS over the past ten (10) years;
  • Specific Experience: Successful implementation of at least one (1) consultancy assignments within the last seven (7) years, each with a contract value of no less than
    $0.3 million, focused on core areas of this TOR. These include:
  • Audit reviews of annual consolidated financial statements of enterprises prepared in accordance with IFRS.
  • IFI Experience: Demonstrable experience of successfully completed assignments in similar contexts) on water supply and sanitation projects funded by International Financial Institutions (IFIs) over the past ten (10) years.

Pemerintah Republik Indonesia telah menerima bantuan dana berupa pinjaman dari World Bank untuk membiayai Ocean for Prosperity Project – LAUTRA dan bermaksud untuk menggunakan sebagian dari dana pinjaman tersebut untuk membiayai Paket Kontrak Layanan Jasa Konsultan Individu.
Tujuan penugasan Konsultan Individu Asisten Ahli Pengelolaan Pesisir Untuk Kegiatan Reviu-Update Rencana Zonasi Kawasan Konservasi Pulau Mare Provinsi Maluku Utara adalah untuk mendukung pelaksanaan Proyek LAUTRA serta membantu koordinasi dengan seluruh pemangku kepentingan (KKP, Bappenas, Pemerintah Provinsi dan Kabupaten/Kota). Kegiatan ini akan dilaksanakan oleh 1 (satu) Konsultan Individu selama jangka waktu 3 (tiga) bulan sejak tanggal dimulainya penugasan, Kerangka Acuan Kerja yang lebih rinci untuk penugasan ini dapat diakses melalui tautan https://tinyurl.com/ASSISTANT-MARE

Direktorat Jenderal Pengelolaan Kelautan Cq Loka PSPL Sorong mengundang Konsultan Individu yang memenuhi syarat untuk menyampaikan minat dalam memberikan Jasa sebagaimana dimaksud. Konsultan Individu yang berminat harus memberikan informasi yang menunjukkan bahwa mereka memiliki kualifikasi yang diperlukan dan pengalaman relevan untuk melaksanakan Jasa tersebut (dilengkapi dengan curriculum vitae yang memuat uraian pengalaman dalam penugasan serupa, kondisi serupa, dan lain-lain, termasuk Surat Pengantar dan surat referensi). Kriteria kualifikasi adalah sebagai berikut:

  1. Gelar Sarjana dalam disiplin ilmu Kelautan/Perikanan/lingkungan/Biologi/Geografi
  2. Paling sedikit 6 (enam) bulanpengalaman yang relevan sebagai surveyor (dalam proyek pengelolaan ekosistem laut/pesisir/penataan ruang laut), lebih disukai dengan program multilateral yang didanai donor misalnya Bank Dunia, Bank Pembangunan Asia, dan Lembaga Donor pembangunan multilateral lainnya
  3. Berpengalaman bekerja pada program Kelautan dan Perikanan dan/atau pendampingan masyarakat di Indonesia minimal selama 6 (enam) bulan
  4. Memiliki keahlian dalam Sistem Informasi Geografis (SIG) dan/atau Penginderaan Jauh/Remote Sensing lebih diutamakan
  5. Memiliki sertifikat sebagai pilot drone lebih diutamakan
  6. Memiliki sertifikat selam minimal A1/Basic/Setara lebih diutamakan
  7. Memiliki kemampuan dalam membuat analisis penginderaan jauh kelautan dan perikanan lebih diutamakan
  8. Memiliki pengalaman minimal 6 (enam) bulan dalam monitoring dan/atau analisis data biofisik, sosial ekonomi dan budaya sektor Kelautan dan Perikanan.

Konsultan Individu yang berminat harap memperhatikan prosedur dalam paragraph 3.14, 3.16 dan 3.17 dari The World Bank Procurement Regulations for IPF Borrowers, Sixth Edition February 2025 (“Regulation”) tentang kebijakan Bank dunia mengenai konflik kepentingan. Informasi lebih lanjut dapat diperoleh di alamat berikut selama jam kerja (08.00 hingga 16.00 WIB/GMT+7)

procnotices.notice_text:
REQUEST FOR EXPRESSION OF INTEREST
INDIVIDUAL CONSULTANT FOR PREPARATION OF 
SITEPLAN & DED FOR LIFULEO VILLAGE

Loan No. IBRD-94980
Reference No. ID-MMAF-510322-CS-INDV

The Ministry of Marine Affairs and Fisheries has received financing from the World Bank toward the cost of the Oceans for Prosperity Project (henceforth LAUTRA). The LAUTRA Project is a strategic initiative aimed at strengthening the sustainable management of Indonesia’s marine protected areas. Its main focus is to preserve marine and coastal resources (MCR) through an ecosystem-based approach while also creating viable and sustainable livelihood alternatives for communities living in and around conservation areas. These efforts are undertaken to ensure that marine biodiversity protection also provides direct benefits to coastal community welfare.
In its implementation, LAUTRA not only focuses on conservation aspects but also promotes the strengthening of the local economy through the development of potential sectors such as capture fisheries, aquaculture, and nature-based tourism. These three sectors were chosen because they hold significant economic potential and can be developed sustainably if managed with the right approach. Therefore, this project plays an important role in reducing pressure on natural resources by providing environmentally friendly and competitive alternatives.
The Ministry of Marine Affairs and Fisheries, through the Directorate of Marine Services, promotes strategies to increase economic opportunities for local communities through the development of marine tourism in conservation areas. Community-based marine tourism development, supported by infrastructure and facilities as well as sustainable productive economic assistance, is expected to increase local community income and provide opportunities for communities living in and around conservation areas to develop their businesses. 

As for construction-related facilities and infrastructure, they must be preceded by the preparation of a site plan and DED in order to obtain design drawings and cost estimates for these facilities and infrastructure. These design drawings and cost estimates will be used as a reference for the procurement of goods and services. Therefore, the Directorate of Marine Services, Directorate General of Marine Management, will recruit an individual planning consultant to prepare the site plan, Detailed Engineering Design (DED) and cost estimates. The activity will be executed by 1 (one) Individual Consultant for 1 (one) month from the start date. Further detailed Terms of Reference (TOR) for the assignment can be found at the following link: https://bit.ly/MMAF-LAUTRA-IC-TOR

The Ministry of Marine Affairs and Fisheries now invite eligible individual consultant (“Consultant”) to indicate their interest in providing the Services. Interested Consultant should provide information demonstrating that they have the required qualifications and relevant experience to perform the Services (attach curriculum vitae with description of experience in similar assignments, similar conditions, etc. including a cover letter and reference letter). The qualification criteria are as follows:

  1. Master degree (S2) in a relevant field (e.g., Civil Engineering, Architecture).
  2. Has 7 years of experience in construction planning services or in similar assignments related to construction services
  3. At least have a certificate of expertise competency in construction services (SKK) with associate level (Madya)
  4. Able to operate/master civil engineering software (e.g., AutoCAD, SketchUp, etc.)
  5. Has experience in preparing site plans, Detailed Engineering Designs (DED), or other similar planning assignments relevant to infrastructure development, with a track record of at least one completed project in government or private sectors within the last several years.
  6. Preferably domiciled in East Nusa Tenggara Province (NTT).

Attention of interested Consultants is drawn to Section III, paragraphs 3.14, 3.16 and 3.17 of the World Bank’s Procurement Regulations for IPF Borrowers dated September 2023 (“the Regulations”), setting forth the World Bank’s policy on conflict of interest.

Further information can be obtained at the address below during office hours (08.00 to16.00 GMT+7). Expressions of interest must be delivered in a written form along with cover letter, curriculum vitae and reference letter to the address below by e-mail and submit the submission form on: https://bit.ly/MMAF-IC-LAUTRA no later than Wednesday, October 15th, 2025 at 16.00 GMT+7.

REQUEST FOR EXPRESSIONS OF INTEREST

(CONSULTING SERVICES – FIRMS SELECTION)

The Cooperative Republic of Guyana

Guyana Strengthening Human Capital Through Education Project

Loan No. (P177741)

Assignment Title: development of a national standard operating procedure (sop), early warning system (ews), and reintegration framework for secondary school dropout prevention in guyana

Reference No. (as per Procurement Plan): GY-MOE-532064-CS-QCBS

The Government of Guyana has received financing from the World Bank toward the cost of the Guyana Strengthening Human Capital Through Education Project and intends to apply part of the proceeds for consulting services.

The consulting services (“the Services”) overall objective is to develop a robust, practical, and multi-stakeholder SOP and associated tools for the identification, support, mitigation, and reintegration of students at risk of dropping out, or who are already out of the secondary school system in Guyana.

The detailed Terms of Reference (TOR) for the assignment may be obtained by interested consulting firms on the submission of an application via email to hcp.procurement@moe.gov.gy. Consulting firms are required to indicate business name, an e-mail address, and contact person in their letter, where the TOR package can be sent to the firms.

The Ministry of Education now invites eligible consulting firms (“Consultants”) to indicate their interest in providing the Services. Interested Consultants should provide information demonstrating that they have the required qualifications and relevant experience to perform the Services. The shortlisting criteria are a) Experience in conducting similar types of assignment/ study which includes experience in developing SOPs, frameworks, national policies, or student support systems, b) minimum of seven (7) years of proven professional experience in at least two of the following areas: (Education policy or systems strengthening, Student welfare, guidance and counselling, Social protection or child protection systems & Juvenile justice, youth development, or school retention programmes), c) Proven experience local capacity & knowledge requirement, d) number of years in business and e) technical and managerial capability of the firm. Key Experts will not be evaluated at the shortlisting stage.

The attention of interested Consultants is drawn to Section III, paragraphs, 3.14, 3.16, and 3.17 of the World Bank’s “Procurement Regulations for IPF Borrowers” February 2025 (“Procurement Regulations”), setting forth the World Bank’s policy on conflict of interest.

Consultants may associate with other firms to enhance their qualifications but should indicate clearly whether the association is in the form of a joint venture and/or a sub-consultancy. In the case of a joint venture, all the partners in the joint venture shall be jointly and severally liable for the entire contract, if selected.

A Consultant will be selected in accordance with the Consultant’s Qualification-based Selection method set out in the Procurement Regulations.

procnotices.notice_text:
RÉPUBLIQUE DE DJIBOUTI

Unité-Égalité-Paix

 

Ministère de l'Agriculture, de l'eau, de la Pêche, de l'Élevage

et des Ressources Halieutiques (MAEPE-RH )

 

UNITE DE GESTION DE PROJETS (UGP)

 

PROJET DE DJIBOUTI POUR LA RESILIENCE DES EAUX SOUTERRAINES ET L'APPROVISIONNEMENT

(DIJRESA)

P511492

 

 

AVIS A MANIFESTATION D'INTERÊT

AMI : N°02/AMI/GFPP/2026

 DATE DE PUBLICATION : 11/02/2026

 

RECRUTEMENT D'UN BUREAU POUR L'ELABORATION D'UN MANUEL/GUIDELINE NATIONAL DE CONCEPTION ET D'EXPLOITATION DES INFRASTRUCTURES HYDRAULIQUES EAU EN MILIEU RURAL

(Réf. DJ-DHR-525055-CS-CQS)

 

La République de Djibouti a reçu un financement de l'Association Internationale de Développement (IDA) pour couvrir le coût du Projet DJIRESA et a l'intention d'utiliser une partie de ce financement dans le cadre de la phase préparatoire GFPP pour effectuer des paiements au titre du marché de service relatif au recrutement d'un bureau pour l'élaboration d'un manuel/guideline national de conception et d'exploitation des infrastructures hydrauliques eau en milieu rural.

L'objectif principal de la consultation est d'élaborer, pour le compte de la Direction de l'Hydraulique Rurale, un manuel national pour la conception, la mise en œuvre et l'exploitation de l'approvisionnement en eau. Ce manuel servira de guide technique national pour tout organisme gouvernemental, projet ou partenaire participant à la construction d'infrastructures d'approvisionnement en eau souterraine et de surface à Djibouti. Le manuel distinguera les paramètres de conception des approvisionnements en eau urbains, périurbains et ruraux.

L'Unité de gestion du projet du MAEPE-RH invite dès à présent les firmes de consultants recevables (« Consultants ») à faire partie de leur intérêt à fournir les Services. Les consultants spécialisés dans ce domaine et intéressés par cet avis, sont invités à retirer les Termes de Référence (TDRS) à l'adresse mentionnée ci-dessous     

 

Les consultants intéressés doivent fournir des informations démontrant qu'ils possèdent les qualifications requises et l'expérience pertinente pour exécuter les Services.

 

Les critères de sélection sont les suivants :

 

Le bureau d'études doit être en activité depuis au moins quinze (15) ans à la date de soumission des dossiers et justifier d'une expérience confirmée d'au moins dix (10) ans dans le domaine de l'eau et de l'assainissement.

  • Le bureau d'études doit avoir réalisé au moins 2 missions similaires au cours des 10 dernières années, dans des contextes arides et ruraux, notamment en Afrique (les références devront être appuyées par des attestations de bonne fin d'exécution, pages de garde et de signature des contrats).
  • Le bureau d'études doit justifier d'expériences réalisées spécifiquement en zones arides ou semi-arides et en milieu rural africain. (Les références devront être appuyées par des attestations de bonne fin d'exécution, pages de garde et de signature des contrats).

 

Les experts clés ne seront pas évalués à l'étape de la préparation de la liste restreinte.

 

Il est porté à l'attention des firmes intéressées que les dispositions sur la Section III, les paragraphes 3.14, 3.16 et 3.17 du Règlement de Passation des Marchés pour les Emprunteurs sollicitant le financement des projets d'investissement (septembre 2025) exposant la politique de la Banque mondiale en matière de conflits d'intérêts sont applicables.

Les sociétés de conseil seront sélectionnées selon la méthode « Sélection fondée sur la qualité (SQC) » telle que décrite dans les règlements de passation de marchés de la Banque Mondiale, Version 2025.

Les manifestations d'intérêt, faites en langue française seront déposées sous plis fermés ou par courrier à l'adresse mentionnée ci-dessous au plus tard le 25/02/2026 à 08 heures 30 (heure locale).

Les manifestations d'intérêt devront porter la mention suivante : « Manifestation d'intérêt pour Le recrutement d'un bureau pour l'élaboration d'un manuel/ligne directrice nationale de conception et d'exploitation des infrastructures hydrauliques eau en milieu rural.

procnotices.notice_text:
REQUEST FOR EXPRESSION OF INTEREST

REPUBLIC OF TAJIKISTAN

MINISTRY OF EDUCATION AND SCIENCE OF THE REPUBLIC OF TAJIKISTAN

LEARNING ENVIRONMENT – FOUNDATION OF QUALITY EDUCATION PROJECT (LEARN)

CONSULTING SERVICES

REFERENCE NO.: MOES/LEARN/IC/2025-01

POSITION: PR SPECIALIST FOR PROJECT LEARN

GRANT NO.: IDA-E1560

Closing Date/Time: February 22, 2026, 17:00 (Dushanbe time)

1. Introduction

The Government of the Republic of Tajikistan has received grant funding in the amount of USD 50.0 million from the World Bank to implement the "Learning Environment – Foundation of Quality Education Project" (LEARN) from 2023 to 2029. The Project is being implemented by the Ministry of Education and Science (MOES) in collaboration with the Agency for Supervision in the Sphere of Education and Science (ASSES).

2. Objectives of the Assignment

The PR Specialist will be responsible for managing and maintaining the Project LEARN website and official social media channels. The specialist will ensure timely and accurate updates on project-related activities, meetings, and key achievements. These updates will be communicated in a clear and engaging manner to inform and involve stakeholders, partners, and the wider public.

Detailed Terms of Reference (ToR) can be accessed via the following link: https://docs.google.com/document/d/14JQ8F5XGysM-POtWyVBxlRtaPHWDBOQsHKAokdDKVa4/edit?usp=sharing

3. Qualifications and Requirements

The consultant should meet the following qualifications:

  • A degree in Public Relations, Communications, Journalism, or a related field. A postgraduate degree will be an advantage.
  • A minimum of 5 years of professional experience in public relations, media relations, or communications, preferably in an international or development project context.
  • Demonstrated experience in managing PR campaigns and media relations, with a proven track record of successful public communication.
  • Familiarity with the education sector and understanding of the challenges and opportunities within the context of the Republic of Tajikistan will be considered an advantage.
  • Strong written and verbal communication skills, with the ability to craft compelling narratives and deliver clear messages to various audiences.
  • Ability to work independently and as part of a team, with excellent organizational and time-management skills.
  • Strong computer skills, including proficiency in Microsoft Office, social media platforms, and basic design tools.
  • Fluency in Russian is required; knowledge of Tajik and English will be an advantage.
  • Proven ability to work effectively with government stakeholders, media, and the general public.
  • Two reference letters from recent employers or relevant professional contacts.

4. Submission of Expression of Interest

The Ministry of Education and Science of the Republic of Tajikistan/ Learning Environment – Foundation of Quality Education Project (LEARN) now invites eligible individual consultants to express their interest in providing the requested services. Interested consultants must submit:

  • A CV detailing their qualifications, skills, and experience.
  • Copies of relevant documents evidencing their qualifications.
  • References and descriptions of similar assignments performed.

Interested consultants are requested to clearly indicate the Reference No. in the subject line of their email.

Expressions of interest will be evaluated in accordance with the World Bank’s “Procurement Regulations for IPF Borrowers” (July 2016, revised in November 2017, July 2018, and November 2020, September 2023, February 2025, September 2025), specifically Sections III, paragraphs 3.14, 3.16, and 3.17, concerning the World Bank’s conflict of interest policy.

A consultant will be selected using the Individual Consultants (IC) method as outlined in the Consultant Guidelines.

5. Further Information

Interested consultants may obtain further information at the contact details below during office hours, 09:00 to 17:00 (Dushanbe, Tajikistan time).

6. Deadline for Submission

Expressions of interest must be delivered no later than February 22, 2026, at 17:00 (Dushanbe time) to the address below:

Manager of the Learning Environment –

Foundation of Quality Education Project (LEARN)

13A Nisormuhammad street, Dushanbe, Tajikistan

SOLICITAÇÃO DE MANIFESTAÇÃO DE INTERESSE

1 ESPECIALISTA DE MONITORIA E AVALIAÇÃO

CONSULTORIA INDIVIDUAL HEPRR-AO/C-006

País: Angola

Nome do Projecto: Projecto de Preparação, Resposta e Resiliência a Emergências de Saúde em Angola (HEPRR) Título de Contracto: Contratação de Serviços de Consultoria

Empréstimo No.: 9562-AO RFP

Referência No.: HEPRR-AO/C-006

O Governo de Angola recebeu uma doação no valor equivalente de USD 1.9 milhões de Dólares Norte Americanos, com o Banco Internacional de Reconstrução e Desenvolvimento (BIRD) do Grupo Banco Mundial, para a implementação do Projecto de Preparação, Resposta e Resiliência a Emergências de Saúde em Angola (HEPRR) e pretende aplicar parte dos recursos na contratação de um (1) Especialista de Monitoria e Avaliação. O objectivo geral desta consultoria visa apoiar o Planeamento, a Implementação e o Acompanhamento das atividades do Projeto HEPRR, assegurando a recolha, análise e reporte de dados confiáveis, a avaliação de resultados e impactos, e o cumprimento das normas, procedimentos e indicadores definidos pelo projeto e pelos financiadores, promovendo transparência, eficiência e tomada de decisão baseada em evidências. A consultoria terá a duração de nove (9) meses, renováveis em função do desempenho satisfatório, da disponibilidade financeira e das necessidades do projecto. Os termos de referência podem ser obtidos no endereço electrónico abaixo indicado.

O Projecto de Preparação, Resposta e Resiliência a Emergências de Saúde em Angola (HEPRR), convida por este meio os consultores individuais ("Consultores") elegíveis a manifestarem o seu interesse em prestar os Serviços. Os consultores interessados deverão fornecer informações que demonstrem que possuem as qualificações requeridas e experiência relevante para executar os serviços, submetendo o seu curriculum vitae, certificados/diplomas académicos, comprovativos de experiência profissional e outros documentos de suporte que se achem necessários para a candidatura.

O(A) Consultor(a) deverá possuir as seguintes qualificações: Formação Académica • Licenciatura em Ciências Sociais, Economia, Saúde Pública ou áreas relacionadas com Monitoramento e Avaliação; • Bacharelado com experiência adicional relevante também será considerado. Experiência Profissional • Mínimo de 10 anos de experiência em monitoramento e avaliação de projetos e programas, incluindo gestão de sistemas de M&A; • Conhecimento comprovado do Sistema Nacional de Informação em Saúde; • Experiência no apoio ao desenvolvimento e supervisão de atividades de M&A do nível central ao municipal; • Pelo menos 5 anos de experiência na elaboração de relatórios de progresso de projetos de saúde; • Experiência na coordenação de atividades de formação sobre sistemas de monitoramento e avaliação. Habilidades e Competências Técnicas • Fortes habilidades de análise de dados e experiência prática com softwares como SPSS, SAS, STATA, EpiInfo, DHIS2 ou equivalentes; • Excelente comunicação, redação de relatórios e capacidade de apresentar resultados complexos a diferentes públicos; • Conhecimentos em gestão de projetos, gestão do tempo e resolução de problemas; • Capacidade de priorizar tarefas e cumprir prazos; • Sólido conhecimento de métodos quantitativos e qualitativos de pesquisa e avaliação; • Experiência em gestão de grandes programas de M&A e na capacitação de equipes; • Experiência na criação de ferramentas de recolha de dados e treinamento em M&A; • Habilidade de facilitação e recolha de informações com segurança e precisão, respeitando diversidade de idade, sexo ou outros fatores; • Capacidade de lidar com múltiplas tarefas, iniciativa própria e resolução de problemas; • Histórico de desempenho consistente em ambientes de alta pressão. • Os consultores serão avaliados com base nas Normas e Regulamentos de Aquisições do Banco Mundial para Mutuários de Financiamentos de Projectos de Investimento de Setembro de 2023, pelo que deverão ter em atenção à Secção III, parágrafos 3.14, 3.16, e 3.17 das referidas Normas, que definem a política do Banco Mundial sobre o conflito de interesses. O referido documento pode ser consultado na seguinte hiperligação: https://thedocs.worldbank.org/en/doc/6c0602876d68949e80820507d90a14ed-0290012023/original/Procurement Regulations-September-2023.pdf. O(A)

Consultor(a) será selecionado com base no método de contratação de Consultores Individuais de acordo com as Normas e Regulamentos de Aquisições em vigor (Setembro 2023). Os Consultores interessados poderão obter informação adicional, incluindo os TORs (Termos de Referência) no endereço abaixo indicado de Segunda Feira à Sexta Feira entre as 8H00 – 15H00. As manifestações de interesse (Curricula, cópia dos certificados de habilitações académicas, avaliação de desempenho e outra informação pertinente) deverão ser enviadas até ao dia 14 de Fevereiro de 2026 às 15H00 (Horário de Angola).

procnotices.notice_text:
République Tunisienne

 

AVIS d’Appel d’offre National N° APF2600001

 

La sélection

D’une agence de conseil en communication, en événementiel et/ou en digital pour l’accompagnement du projet Startups et PME Innovantes

 

Tournée Régionale et communication Digitale

 

 

Le projet d’appui « Startups et PME Innovantes » a été lancé en mai 2019, par la signature de l’Accord de prêt, en janvier 2020, entre le gouvernement tunisien et la Banque mondiale, suivi de la signature l’Accord de projet entre la Caisse des dépôts et consignations (CDC) et la Banque mondiale (BM). Il s’inscrit dans le cadre du programme national « start-up Tunisia », sous la tutelle du ministère des Technologies de la communication et de la transformation digitale et du ministère de l’Economie et de la Planification.

Le projet d’appui « Startups et PME Innovantes », financé principalement par la Banque mondiale, vise à catalyser la création et le développement des start-up et PME innovantes tout en stimulant les perspectives économiques et d’emploi pour la jeunesse tunisienne. Le projet est exécuté par la CDC, en collaboration avec « Smart Capital », et permet notamment, la création d’entités-clés chargées de la mise en place d’un pipeline viable pour les investissements futurs.

 

Dans ce cadre, la CDC prévoit de lancer un appel d'offres national pour la sélection d’une agence de conseil en communication, en événementiel et/ou en digital pour l’accompagnement du projet Startups et PME Innovantes.

À la lumière de ces axes principaux, il a été décidé d’initier les actions suivantes, objets du présent appel d’offres à savoir :

Lot 1 : Mise en œuvre des actions de communication digitale et de consulting

 

Lot 2 :  Organisation d’événements régionaux

 

Chaque soumissionnaire peut participer à un lot ou plus (un ou deux). Toutefois, il est à noter que les lots sont uniques et indivisibles.

 

Cet appel d’offres est ouvert à toutes les agences de communication et d’évènementielles, aux institutions spécialisées dans le domaine de la communication et/ou de l’évènementiel et/ou audiovisuelle ayant retiré le cahier des charges et disposant d’une équipe complète de communication.

Les soumissionnaires, intéressés par l’appel d’offre, doivent retirer le cahier des charges auprès du Bureau d’Ordre Central de la CDC, sis au 07, Rue Abou Hamed El Ghazali - Jardins du Japon-Montplaisir- Tunis 1073, ils doivent être muni de leur cachet et de leur carte d’identité nationale.

 La Caisse des Dépôts et Consignations (CDC) invite les soumissionnaires qualifiés (« agences com &/ ou évent ») à manifester leur intérêt à fournir les services décrits ci-dessus. Les soumissionnaires intéressés doivent fournir les informations indiquant qu’ils ont les qualifications et l'expérience requises pour exécuter la mission.

 

Une agence sera sélectionnée conformément à la méthode de sélection énoncée dans le cahier des charges.

 

De plus amples informations peuvent être obtenues à l'adresse ci-dessous pendant les heures de bureau, c'est-à-dire de 08h 00 à 17h 00 (heure locale).

 

 

Les soumissionnaires intéressés devront transmettre un dossier d’appel d’offre comprenant :

  • Les documents administratifs
  • Les documents de l’offre technique
  • L’offre financière 

 

Les offres doivent parvenir par voie postale sous pli fermé recommandé avec accusé de réception ou par rapide poste ou déposé directement au Bureau d'Ordre Central de la Caisse des Dépôts et Consignations, et ce au plus tard le 10/03/2026 à 14h00 avec la mention :

 

À l’attention de la Directrice Générale de la Caisse des Dépôts et Consignations

« À ne pas ouvrir Appel d’offre N° APF2600001

Sélection d’une agence de conseil en communication, en événementiel et/ou en digital pour l’accompagnement du projet Startups et PME Innovantes_ Tournée Régionale et communication Digitale »

 

  • L’offre technique et l'offre financière doivent être placées dans deux enveloppes séparées et scellées. Ces deux enveloppes seront placées dans une troisième enveloppe extérieure scellée, indiquant les références de l'appel d'offre et son objet. Cette dernière enveloppe ne doit en aucun cas mentionner l'identité du soumissionnaire.
  • Tous les documents administratifs doivent être des originaux ou des copies certifiées conformes valables jusqu’à la date limite de dépôt des offres.
  • Les soumissionnaires seront liés par leurs offres pendant une durée de quatre-vingt-dix (90) jours calendaires à partir du jour suivant la date limite fixée pour la réception des offres.

 

L'ouverture des plis se déroulera en séance publique au siège de la CDC, le 11 mars 2026 à 11h00.

 

 

 

Adresse :

Caisse des Dépôts et Consignations (CDC)

1073 Montplaisir, Tunis, Tunisie

Email : consultation@cdc.tn

Pour toutes informations complémentaires, contacter par tél : 71 905 999/ 71 905 475 ou par

fax : 71 908 213 ou bien par mail : consultation@cdc.tn.

Referencia N°: AR-MFJUJUY-516908-CS-QCBS

La Provincia de Jujuy, República Argentina, ha recibido financiamiento del Banco Mundial, mediante una donación para la preparación del “Proyecto de Infraestructura Resiliente para el Desarrollo Económico Regional y la Creación de Empleo-Jujuy –en el Marco del Programa Provincial De Desarrollo Productivo” - Donación N° TF0C8844-AR, y se propone utilizar una parte de los fondos para el contrato de servicios de consultoría de la referencia, en adelante “los servicios”.

La Secretaría de Programas y Proyectos Estratégicos del Ministerio de Hacienda y Finanzas de la Provincia de Jujuy (UCP), invita a las firmas consultoras elegibles “Consultores” a indicar su interés en proporcionar los servicios. Las expresiones de interés de los consultores interesados son requeridas bajo el párrafo 7.16 de las Regulaciones de Adquisiciones para Prestatarios en Proyecto de Inversión del Banco Mundial (edición febrero 2025). Los servicios comprenden elaborar los Estudios de Preinversión, diseño de detalle y elaboración del Proyecto para la Obra del Nodo Logístico Intermodal, que incluirá:

  • Infraestructura interna y de servicios (vial, eléctrica, agua potable, cloacas industriales, drenaje pluvial).
  • Plan maestro de urbanización industrial.
  • Proyecto ejecutivo de la ampliación del Parque Industrial Perico, clave para fortalecer la conectividad logística de la región.
  • Diseño de la red ferroviaria y sus peines
  • Construcción de una cámara de frio
  • Cómputos, presupuestos, memorias técnicas y pliegos listos para licitación.

Además deberá efectuar el EsIAS del Proyecto según lo establecido en la Ley General de Medio Ambiente Nº 5063 y su decreto reglamentario Nº 7751/23 de la Provincia de Jujuy  y el Marco Ambiental y social (MAS) del Banco Mundial.

Esta consultoría permitirá avanzar hacia una infraestructura productiva moderna con estándares internacionales, que impulsará la radicación de nuevas industrias, generará empleo calificado y posicionará a la provincia de Jujuy como parte del corredor bioceánico y de la red ferroviaria nacional.

En el documento preliminar de Términos de Referencia (TdR) que se adjuntan como Anexo 1 se ofrecen más detalles sobre los servicios de consultoría. Éstos TdR consisten en una versión preliminar que el contratante podrá ajustar y modificar. La versión definitiva de los TdR será remitida a las firmas que sean seleccionadas para conformar la lista corta, al momento de invitarlas a presentar Propuestas Técnica y de Precio para la contratación de la ejecución de las tareas.

Los Consultores interesados deberán proporcionar información que demuestre que tienen las calificaciones requeridas y la experiencia relevante para prestar los Servicios.

Particularmente, las firmas consultoras deberán demostrar experiencia en diseño ejecutivo de obras de infraestructura de gran escala, proyectos de parques industriales, plataformas logísticas. Preferentemente, se apreciará que tales servicios se hayan prestado el marco de proyectos financiados por organismos multilaterales.

Esta información deberá presentarse de acuerdo al Anexo N° 1. Asimismo, deberá adjuntarse copia de constancias de la ejecución de estos antecedentes y contacto de referencia actualizado. Los consultores deberán proporcionar informar que indique el alcance de cada trabajo presentado como antecedente, indicando si comprendieron la ejecución de estudios sociales o ambientales, el desarrollo de documentación licitatoria de las obras con eventual financiamiento de organismos internacionales y/o el desarrollo de proyectos ejecutivos de obras de similar envergadura y naturaleza. Se deberá indicar lugar de los trabajos, descripción de los mismos, métodos utilizados, duración del proyecto, fecha de inicio, fecha de terminación, monto aproximado del contrato, equipo de trabajo asignados y cualquier otro dato que considere útil.

  1. En base a las presentaciones de los interesados, la UCP conformará una Lista Corta con las firmas que se consideren más apropiadas para que participen en la posterior selección. La lista podrá estar compuesta enteramente de consultores nacionales, la misma tendrá un máximo de 8 (ocho) empresas.

Se llama la atención de los Consultores interesados sobre la Sección III, párrafos 3.14, 3.16 y 3.17 de las “Regulaciones de Adquisiciones para Prestatarios para PFI” del Banco Mundial, séptima edición septiembre de 2025, que establece la política del Banco Mundial sobre conflictos de intereses.

El proceso de selección del consultor que prestará los servicios se llevará adelante mediante el método Selección Basada en Calidad y Costo (SBCC), conforme a las Regulaciones de Adquisiciones del Banco Mundial ya mencionadas.

Los consultores se podrán asociar con otras firmas en forma de asociación en participación (Joint Venture) o presentar subconsultores con el fin de mejorar sus calificaciones.

Los Consultores interesados podrán obtener más información en la dirección indicada al final de este llamado, durante horas hábiles en horario de 8:00 am hasta 14:00pm.

 

Las expresiones de interés deberán ser remitidas personalmente, por correo postal o correo electrónico, a más tardar 20/02/2026 a las 13.00 horas. Para envíos superiores a 5 Megabytes de manera digital únicamente podrán recibirse mediante link de descarga. Solicítese acuse de recibido a fin de constatar la correcta recepción del envío.

REQUEST FOR EXPRESSIONS OF INTEREST

(CONSULTING SERVICES – FIRMS SELECTION)

SAINT VINCENT AND THE GRENADINES (SVG)

BERYL EMERGENCY RESILIENT RECOVERY PROJECT (BERRy)

(IDA 76430)

Assignment Title: Design and supervision consultancy for the rehabilitation of the Bequia Fisheries Complex

Reference No. SVG-BERRY-CS-QCBS-02

The Government of Saint Vincent and the Grenadines (GoSVG) has received financing from the World Bank toward the cost of the Beryl Emergency Resilient Recovery Project, and it intends to apply part of the proceeds for consulting services for the design and supervision consultancy for the rehabilitation of the Bequia Fisheries Complex.

 The consulting services (“the Services”) include the following:

  1. The conducting of a thorough engineering analysis of the complex facilities and prepare detailed architectural/engineering designs for the repair and rehabilitation of the Bequia Fisheries Centre.
  2. The assessment and design of all required activities to rehabilitate the Fisheries Centre  including all operational buildings and support equipment. 
  3. The provision all technical documentation required to support the procurement of a construction contractor to complete the required works.
  4. The provision of technical support to assist the GoSVG with construction and equipment bidding processes including proposal evaluations and contractor selection for the execution of the works.

The duration of this consultancy is estimated to be 18 months (6 months for the design phase and 12 months for the supervision phase).

The Terms of Reference (TOR) for the assignment can be accessed using the following link:

https://procurement.gov.vc/eprocure/images/pdf/CurrentBids/Bequia%20Fisheries%20Complex%20-%20REoI%20-%20Website%20-%20February%202026.pdf

The Ministry of Finance, Economic Planning and Private Sector Development now invites eligible consulting firms (“Consultants”) to indicate their interest in providing the Services. Interested consultants must provide information demonstrating that they have the required qualifications and relevant experience to perform the Services. The shortlisting criteria are:

  1. Firms should have experience in fisheries, agriculture, or coastal infrastructure projects (rehabilitation, modernization, sustainability). 
  2. Firms should have completed at least two (2) comparable projects in the last ten (10) years (preferably fisheries complexes, aquaculture facilities, or agricultural processing plants).

 Key Experts will not be evaluated at this shortlisting stage.

The attention of interested Consultants is drawn to Section III, paragraphs, 3.14, 3.16, and 3.17 of the World Bank’s “Procurement Regulations for IPF Borrowers” 5th Edition September 2023 (“Procurement Regulations”), setting forth the World Bank’s policy on conflict of interest. In addition, consultants shall refer to the requirements on conflict of interest related to this assignment as per paragraph 3.17 of the Procurement Regulations. 

Consultants may associate with other firms to enhance their qualifications but should indicate clearly whether the association is in the form of a joint venture and/or a sub-consultancy. In the case of a joint venture, all the partners in the joint venture shall be jointly and severally liable for the entire contract, if selected.

A Consultant will be selected in accordance with the Consultant’s Quality and Cost Based Selection (QCBS) method set out in the Procurement Regulations.

Further information can be obtained at the address below during office hours 9:00am to 4:00pm EST.

 Expressions of interest must be delivered in a written form to the address below (in person, or by mail, or by fax, or by e-mail) by 16:00 hours (or 4:00pm SVG time) February 27, 2026.

STATE DEPARTMENT FOR DEVOLUTION

REQUEST FOR EXPRESSION OF INTEREST

(CONSULTING SERVICES-INDIVIDUAL CONSULTANT SELECTION-IC)

Country                                 : Kenya

Name of Project                  : Second Kenya Devolution Support Program KDSP-II

Credit No                              : IDA-7447-KE

Project ID No                       : P180935

Assignment Title                : Individual consultants (4No.) to verify achievement of Disbursement-linked indicators 1, 3 and 4 for the FY 2024/25

Reference No                       : KE-SDD-535640-CS-INDV

  1. The Government of Kenya (GoK) has received funding from the World Bank towards the cost of Second Kenya Devolution Support Program KDSP-II, and intends to apply part of the proceeds toward payments under the contract for consulting services. The Program has three key result areas;

(i) Sustainable Financing and Expenditure Management. This KRA supports efforts towards enhancing financing to, and expenditure management by counties.

(ii) Intergovernmental Coordination, Institutional Performance, and Human Resource Management. This KRA supports national and county government initiatives towards strengthening intergovernmental coordination, institutional performance, and Human Resource Management (HRM), and

(iii) Oversight, Participation, and Accountability. KRA 3 will support improvements in oversight, participation, and accountability. The IPF component will support the development of guidelines on project stocktaking, community-led project management committees, and climate change risk screening and preparedness (including assessment of the climate resilience of existing infrastructure assets).

Specific Disbursement Linked Indicators (DLIs) have been developed to monitor results for each of the three result areas.

  1. The overall objective of the consultancy is to assess the achievement of Disbursement-linked indicators (DLI) 1 and to assess counties on the achievement of Disbursement-linked indicators (DLI) 3 &4, performance measures for DLI 3&4.
  2. The attention of interested Consultants is drawn to Section III, paragraphs,3.14, 3.16, and 3.17 of the World Bank’s “Procurement Regulations for IPF Borrowers” Procurement Regulations of September 2023, setting forth the World Bank’s policy on conflict of interest.
  3.  The State Department for Devolution now invites eligible individual consultants to submit Expressions of interest for consideration. Interested consultants must provide information demonstrating that they have the required qualifications and relevant experience to provide the services. The selection criteria will be as indicated in the TORs.
  4. A consultant will be selected in accordance with the procedures set out in the World Bank’s Guidelines: Selection and Employment of Consultants [under IBRD Loans and IDA Credits & Grants] by World Bank Borrowers.
  5. Interested Individual Consultants may obtain further information at the address below from 0900 to 1700 hours East African Time (EAT) from Monday to Friday excluding lunch hour (1300 to 1400hours EAT) and public holidays.
  6. The terms of reference are available on The Public Procurement Information Portal https://tenders.go.ke, and the State Department for Devolution Website https://www.devolution.go.ke.
  7. Interested Individual Consultants should submit their expression of interest, which must be delivered in a written form and must be accompanied with copies CVs and copies of relevant documents and testimonials/recommendations (copies of Academic and Professional Qualifications and Registration/Licensing Certificates) in plain sealed envelope clearly marked: Individual consultants (4 No.) to verify achievement of Disbursement-linked indicators 1, 3 and 4 for the FY 2024/25 Reference No. KE-SDD-535640-CS-INDV and addressed (in person, or by e-mail) to;

 

The Principal Secretary,

State Department for Devolution
P.O. Box 30004 - 00100 Nairobi.

Attention: Program Coordinator KDSPII

E-mail: secondkdsp@gmail.com

8. The Expression of Interest shall be delivered using one of the following modalities;

  1. Deposit in the Tender Box located on 5th Floor Teleposta Towers - Kenyatta Avenue Nairobi, Kenya.
  2. Send via email to; secondkdsp@gmail.com

STATE DEPARTMENT FOR DEVOLUTION

REQUEST FOR EXPRESSION OF INTEREST

(CONSULTING SERVICES-INDIVIDUAL CONSULTANT SELECTION-IC)

Country                                 : Kenya

Name of Project                  : Second Kenya Devolution Support Program KDSP-II

Credit No                              : IDA-7447-KE

Project ID No                       : P180935

Assignment Title                : Individual consultant (4No.) to verify achievement of Disbursement-linked indicators 7 and Minimum Conditions (for level 2 grant) for the FY 2024/25

Reference No                       : KE-SDD-535644-CS-INDV

  1. The Government of Kenya (GoK) has received funding from the World Bank towards the cost of Second Kenya Devolution Support Program KDSP-II, and intends to apply part of the proceeds toward payments under the contract for consulting services. The Program has three key result areas;

(i) Sustainable Financing and Expenditure Management. This KRA supports efforts towards enhancing financing to, and expenditure management by counties.

(ii) Intergovernmental Coordination, Institutional Performance, and Human Resource Management. This KRA supports national and county government initiatives towards strengthening intergovernmental coordination, institutional performance, and Human Resource Management (HRM), and

(iii) Oversight, Participation, and Accountability. KRA 3 will support improvements in oversight, participation, and accountability. The IPF component will support the development of guidelines on project stocktaking, community-led project management committees, and climate change risk screening and preparedness (including assessment of the climate resilience of existing infrastructure assets).

Specific Disbursement Linked Indicators (DLIs) have been developed to monitor results for each of the three result areas.

  1. The overall objective of the consultancy is to assess performance of counties on the achievement of Disbursement-linked indicators (DLI) 7, performance measures for DLI 7 and Minimum Conditions (for level 2 grant).
  2. The attention of interested Consultants is drawn to Section III, paragraphs,3.14, 3.16, and 3.17 of the World Bank’s “Procurement Regulations for IPF Borrowers” Procurement Regulations of September 2023, setting forth the World Bank’s policy on conflict of interest.
  3.  The State Department for Devolution now invites eligible individual consultants to submit Expressions of interest for consideration. Interested consultants must provide information demonstrating that they have the required qualifications and relevant experience to provide the services. The short listing criteria will be as indicated in the TORs.
  4. A consultant will be selected in accordance with the procedures set out in the World Bank’s Guidelines: Selection and Employment of Consultants [under IBRD Loans and IDA Credits & Grants] by World Bank Borrowers.
  5. Interested Individual Consultants may obtain further information at the address below from 0900 to 1700 hours East African Time (EAT) from Monday to Friday excluding lunch hour (1300 to 1400hours EAT) and public holidays.
  6. The terms of reference are available on The Public Procurement Information Portal https://tenders.go.ke, and the State Department for Devolution Website https://www.devolution.go.ke.
  7. Interested Individual Consultants should submit their expression of interest, which must be delivered in a written form and must be accompanied with copies CVs and copies of relevant documents and testimonials/recommendations (copies of Academic and Professional Qualifications and Registration/Licensing Certificates) in plain sealed envelope clearly marked: Individual consultant (4No.) to verify achievement of Disbursement-linked indicators 7 and Minimum Conditions (for level 2 grant) for the FY 2024/25 Reference No. KE-SDD-535644-CS-INDV and addressed (in person, or by e-mail) to;

 

The Principal Secretary,

State Department for Devolution
P.O. Box 30004 - 00100 Nairobi.

Attention: Program Coordinator KDSPII

E-mail: secondkdsp@gmail.com

8. The Expression of Interest shall be delivered using one of the following modalities;

  1. Deposit in the Tender Box located on 5th Floor Teleposta Towers - Kenyatta Avenue Nairobi, Kenya.
  2. Send via email to; secondkdsp@gmail.com

 

9. Deadline for submission of Expression of Interest is Tuesday 24th February 2026 at 1100 hours East African time.

Note: Late submissions will not be accepted.

REQUEST FOR EXPRESSIONS OF INTEREST

(INDIVIDUAL CONSULTING SERVICES)

Republic of Tajikistan

Start-up Ecosystem for Economic Development (SEED) Project – Project Preparation (GFPP)

Grant No.: P182037

Title: International Consultant on Capacity Building for Entrepreneurship Ecosystem Development

Reference No.: SCIPM/SEED/IC/2026-04

The State Committee on Investment and State Property Management (SCIPM) has received financing from the World Bank toward the preparation of the Start-Up Ecosystem for Economic Development (SEED) Project and intends to apply part of the proceeds for individual consulting services. The assignment is to strengthen the institutional, managerial, and operational capacity of SCIPM and the State Business Incubator (SBI) to effectively design, manage, and deliver entrepreneurship and innovation ecosystem programs. The duration of the assignment shall not exceed eight (8) months.

The detailed Terms of Reference (ToR) for the assignment are available through the following link:https://docs.google.com/document/d/1Y4qoZzooAq2vaezhmW-4E4fRDUre8O97/edit?usp=sharing&ouid=111293175137951339186&rtpof=true&sd=true

SCIPM now invites eligible individual consultants (“Consultants”) to indicate their interest in providing the services. Interested Consultants shall provide information demonstrating that they have the required qualifications and relevant experience to perform the services, including an updated Curriculum Vitae (CV) and a brief cover letter. The criteria for selecting the Consultant are: an advanced degree in economics, business administration, public policy, innovation management, or a related field; at least ten (10) years of proven experience in entrepreneurship ecosystem development, innovation policy, and/or SME/start-up support; demonstrated experience working with public institutions and entrepreneurship support organizations (such as incubators, innovation agencies, universities, or innovation hubs), including institutional strengthening and capacity building; strong knowledge of international good practices in entrepreneurship support programs and ecosystem operations; excellent analytical, facilitation/training and report-writing skills, with the ability to work effectively with multiple stakeholders; experience with World Bank–funded or other donor-financed projects is a strong advantage; and experience in Central Asia or similar contexts is an asset

The attention of interested Consultants is drawn to paragraphs 3.14, 3.16, and 3.17 of the World Bank’s Procurement Regulations for IPF Borrowers, dated February 2025, setting forth the World Bank’s policy on conflict of interest.

NEPAL ELECTRICITY AUTHORITY

(A Government of Nepal Undertaking)

DISTRIBUTION AND CONSUMER SERVICES DIRECTORATE

ELECTRICITY SUPPLY RELIABILITY IMPROVEMENT PROJECT

REQUEST FOR EXPRESSIONS OF INTEREST 

(CONSULTING SERVICES – FIRMS SELECTION)

First Publication Date: February 16, 2026

 

Country: Nepal

Name of Project: Electricity Supply Reliability Improvement Project (ESRIP)

Loan No./ Credit No.: 7769-NP (Credit A), 7770-NP (Credit B- SML)

Assignment Title: Project Supervision Consultant

Reference No.: ESRIP/CS/QCBS-01

 

  1. The Government of Nepal (GoN) has received financing from the World Bank towards the cost for Electricity Supply Reliability Improvement Project (ESRIP) and intends to apply part of the proceeds for consulting services to supervise the construction of 33/11kV Substation and Line Reinforcement Activities.

 

  1. The consulting service (“the Services”) is for the design review and construction supervision of distribution line reinforcement and 33/11kV substation construction projects. In Particular, the principal activities will include, but not limited to the following:
  • Review Design and Drawings during the implementation of Contracts.
  • Construction supervision, quality assurance and inspection for Contracts
  • Verification of Completed Works and Recommendation for Interim and Final Payments

 

 

The estimated duration of these consulting services is Twenty-Four (24) months.

 

  1. The NEA now invites Expression of Interest (EOI) from interested and eligible National Consulting firms (“Consultants”) to provide the above-mentioned Services. Interested consulting firms should provide information demonstrating that they have the required qualifications and relevant experience to perform the Services. All submittals from the consulting firms shall be in English language. All interested consulting firms, including JV firms, must meet the minimum requirements: 
    • have at least seven (7) years of working experience in the relevant field
    • have at least one (1) completed contract as supervision consultant for Distribution System Reinforcement Project. The project should include the scope of 33/11kV substation and 33/11/0.4kV lines.   
  2. Consultants may associate with other firms to enhance their qualifications, but should indicate clearly whether the association is in the form of a joint venture and/or a sub-consultancy. In the case of a joint venture, all the partners in the joint venture shall be jointly and severally liable for the entire contract, if selected.

 

  1. The attention of interested consultant is drawn to paragraph 1.9 of the World Bank’s Guidelines: Selection of Employment of Consultant under IBRD and IDA Credits & Grants by World Bank’s borrower- January 2011, revised July 2014 (“Consultant Guidelines”), setting forth the World Bank’s policy on conflict of interest.

 

  1. EOIs will be evaluated based on the Consultant’s qualification and experience and organization strength of consulting firm. The shortlisting criteria are:
  • Core Business and Years of Experience
  • Relevant Experience
  • Technical Capacity of firm
  • Managerial Capacity of firm

Key Experts will not be evaluated at shortlisting stage.

  1. Based on evaluation of EOI, only shortlisted firms will be invited to submit technical and financial proposal through a request for proposal. A Consultant(s) will be selected in accordance with the Quality and Cost Based (QCBS) selection method set out in the Consultant Guidelines.

 

  1. The Terms of Reference (ToR) and this request for EOI can be either downloaded from the NEA's website: www.nea.org.np or collected from the address mentioned below. Further information can be obtained at the address below during office hours from 10:00 to 17:00 hours.

procnotices.notice_text:
REQUEST FOR EXPRESSIONS OF INTEREST

(INDIVIDUAL CONSULTING SERVICES)

Country: Vanuatu

Name of Project: Pacific Islands Regional Oceanscape Program (P513248)

Credit No: TBA

Assignment Title: Project Coordinator (PC)

Reference No: VU-MFOMA-512232-CS-INDV

  1. The Government of Vanuatu has applied for financing from the World Bank toward the cost of the Pacific Islands Regional Oceanscape Program (PROP) and intends to apply part of the proceeds for consulting services. The project development objective is to improve access to economic opportunities for fishers and fish workers, increase climate-resilient domestic supply of fish products, and strengthen national capacity and regional collaboration for fisheries management.
  2. The implementing agency for this project is the Ministry of Fisheries, Oceans and Maritime Affairs (MFOMA).
  3.  The consulting services (“the Services”) include supporting MFOMA with oversight, coordination, implementation, and monitoring of all aspects of the project. The Project Coordinator will be responsible for the successful set up of the project, timely start of the planned activities, and will contribute to the overall achievement of the project development objective, in close collaboration with Ministry staff.This position is a full-time position with an initial six-month probationary period, with possible yearly extensions subject to performance assessment and budget availability and an ongoing requirement. This position is based in Vanuatu . The expected Project closing date is December 2030 and the expected start date of the assignment is 16 May 2026.
  4. The detailed Terms of Reference (TOR) for the assignment can be obtained by emailing the address given below or by calling in at the Vanuatu Fisheries Department (VFD) situated at the WANTOK building at Number 2 Area.
  5.  MFOMA now invites eligible individuals (“Consultants”) to indicate their interest in providing the Services. Interested Consultants should provide information demonstrating that they have the required qualifications and relevant experience to perform the Services (attach curriculum vitae with description of experience in similar assignments, similar conditions, etc.). Firms’ staff may express interest through the employing firm for the assignment and, under such situation, only the experience and qualifications of individuals shall be considered in the selection process. The criteria for selecting the Consultant are:

Mandatory requirements

  • Bachelor’s Degree in a relevant discipline (project management, business), or other field relevant to this assignment.
  • At least 7 years’ experience in managing projects and project staff and resources, and 3 to 5 years’ experience in roles with similar responsibilities
  •  Demonstrated experience in managing project budgets, with financial systems, and in financial reporting and with preparing project documentation, including policies and procedures (
  • Demonstrated experience in working with multiple stakeholders, (i.e., Ministries, development partners, non-government players, communities, local governments, etc.)
  • Ability to progressively increase responsibilities in project management and staff supervision
  •  Capability to perform efficiently and effectively in a demanding and often constrained working environment, meeting tight deadlines
  •  Capability to manage and coordinate across multiple teams in different locations and within different project sites
  •  Ability to provide oversight in ensuring project activities are implemented on time and on budget.

 

Desirable requirements:

 

  • Excellent communication and interpersonal skills with the ability to make clear, structured presentations to a broad range of audiences; excellent writing skills with the ability to prepare clear, concise reports; oral and written fluency in English.
  • Oral and written skills in Bislama and/or French.
  • Experience with donor (foreign aid) financed programs, preferably with World Bank projects.
  • Good understanding of relevant legislation, policies, procedures, and processes of government.
  • Good understanding of the socioeconomic and technical background of coastal and oceanic fisheries and aquaculture.
  • Experience working in a Pacific Island Country context, preferably in Vanuatu.
  • Relevant post-graduate qualifications.

6. The attention of interested Consultants (including firms) is drawn to paragraph 3.13, 3.15 and 3.16 of the World Bank’s Procurement Regulations for IPF Borrowers (Seventh Edition, September 2025) (“the Regulations”), setting forth the World Bank’s policy on conflict of interest.
